1.title: One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey
1.summary: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia found themselves in the path of the powerful weather system.

2.title: Trump Offered to Sell Arms to China, U.S. Ambassador Says
2.summary: President Trump made the offer to Xi Jinping, China’s leader, said David Perdue, the ambassador to China. The White House later said the U.S. had no plans for such a sale.

3.title: Dario Amodei of Anthropic to Dine With Trump at White House
3.summary: Dario Amodei, who is also the company’s chief executive, will join the president at the White House for a private dinner. Mr. Trump has dismissed his cautions.

5.title: A Transcript From The Times Interview with Prime Minister Mark Carney of Canada
5.summary: New York Times journalists pressed the Canadian prime minister about a range of topics in an hourlong interview last week. Here’s a transcript of their conversation.

6.title: Iran Still Awaits ‘Official’ U.S. Response Despite Trump’s Rebuff of Cease-Fire Offer
6.summary: Abbas Araghchi, Iran’s foreign minister, said a history of contradictory messaging meant that President Trump’s rejection might not be a final position.
